Mirae Asset Securities UK | https://securities.miraeasset.co.uk/ | Software Engineer – Securities Finance | Up to £100k base | London | Hybrid

2–7 yrs Python/Java. Capital markets knowledge useful but not required.

Health insurance, 1d WFH after probation.
